main.description: Pick the next coverage gap (per source×label) via maps_coverage_gap_score UDF, create a collection job for it, and bump last_fetched_at. Idempotent advance of the domain-coverage frontier, driven by BPMN timer or manual invocation.

sourceDid.description: Optional filter: only advance this source DID (e.g. did:web:maps.etzhayyim.com:registry:gleif)

label.description: Optional filter: only advance this spatial label (e.g. LegalEntity, AdminArea, Airport)

advanced.description: Number of gaps for which a job was created (0 on dryRun)

remainingGaps.description: Remaining non-zero gap_score rows in view_maps_coverage_gap_ranked

nextRunHint.description: ISO 8601 timestamp hint for next BPMN tick
